title: sharm DMSO-DMSO with high l (l1, l2 <= 6, l <= 12), mapgr, mapgrentropy
purpose: A precision test of the special functions of `sharm` [@epsrmanual]: high orders lead to large log-factorial arguments in the Clebsch-Gordan coefficients (`cgcoef`) and Wigner rotation matrices (`dlm`), where single-precision rounding must match the Fortran exactly.
fortran: `sharm_rev2.f`: `run_sharm` (keywords, `nsumt` rule), `sharm` (centres, axes, pair loop, averaged molecules)
system: The EPSR-test configuration `200DMSO400Water.ato`: 200 DMSO (atoms S, C, C, O, 6 H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1, H1; SPC/E parameters [@berendsen1987]), 3200 atoms at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å, a model of the DMSO-water mixtures of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. `sharm` expands the orientational pair correlation function of a central and a second molecule type in rotation matrices coupled by Clebsch-Gordan coefficients; the coefficients g(l1,l2,l;n1,n2;r) are averages over all molecule pairs [@soper1994,@graygubbins1984]. Here identical DMSO molecules (centre = mass centre of S, C, C, O; axes -z towards O, y from C 2), l1, l2 = 0 2 4 6, l = 0-12 (even), n1step = n2step = 3: 181 coefficients in `.h01` and `.h02`. `mapgr` rebuilds g(r) along chosen directions and relative orientations from the coefficients (grtype 1 radial, 2 spatial, 3 full orientational). `mapgrentropy` adds to the ideal-gas entropy the two-body excess term, an integral of r²·(g - 1 - g ln g) [@baranyai1989], for the radial, spatial and full g, sampling random orientations with `ran1` [@parkmiller1988].
inputs: Input files written by hand from the keyword tables (`setup_symbols_*`), one `keyword value` per line, ended by `q`; `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied from EPSR-test. `dmso.SHARM.dat` (nr 120, rmax 12); `dmso.mapgr.txt`: radial and two orientational views, smoothing `3.0 2 1 1`; `dmso.mapgrentropy.dat`: 40 trials, nfreq 10.
verification: One pass. The reference shows `ncoeffs 181`, titles up to `(6,6,12;...)` in `dmso.SHARM.h02`, and an entropy output after 40 trials; all files are identical, i.e. every coefficient agrees to the last printed digit. Reference build: `sharm`/`sdf` were rebuilt with one comma inserted in the run-time title format (`'(1h(,'//il1fmt`), since gfortran 15.2 otherwise stops with "Missing comma between descriptors" before writing the coefficients; all other programs are the unmodified reference binaries. Also masked: characters 31-45 of the `*.mapgr.g01` data lines, the error column of `g_centres(r)`, which `mapgrquad.f` never sets (uninitialised in the Fortran, 0 in the port).
